question: Should OpenClaw add first-class persisted rootSessionKey and session-chain traceId fields to SessionEntry and Gateway/tool session listings, and what exact naming/relationship should they have to existing diagnostic trace context?
rationale: These fields would become public persisted session and Gateway/tool API contracts, while current code already has partial parent/depth/ACP lineage and existing diagnostic trace concepts that could conflict with a new traceId field.

options.title: Approve a narrow chain contract
options.body: Choose canonical optional field names and semantics, then request a focused implementation that covers model, native/ACP spawn, Gateway/tool projections, docs, and tests.

options.title: Fold into broader lineage work
options.body: Route this issue under the durable session-lineage/rotation work so one API design owns root, trace, resolver, and client metadata together.

options.title: Defer core fields
options.body: Keep the current spawnedBy, parentSessionKey, and spawnDepth behavior and avoid adding new persisted public fields until a stronger product need is confirmed.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow chain contract
recommendation.body: Choose canonical optional field names and semantics, then request a focused implementation that covers model, native/ACP spawn, Gateway/tool projections, docs, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue already has maintainer triage from steipete, and recent session API work by Peter Steinberger touched the same public contract surfaces.
